d.seg: काफ़ी लोग इसमें बहुत बुरे बुरे भी हो मतलब सीधे डायरेक्ट जो है आएंगे और बहुत बोलते हैं कि आप व्हाट्सअप दीजिए मैंने कहा देखिए ये काम मैं नहीं करती हूँ व्हाट्सअप व्हाट्सअप ना मैं नंबर देती हूँ ना कुछ
d.tr: Many people here are very bad, they come directly and say 'give me WhatsApp'. I said, look, I don't do this work, I don't give my WhatsApp number or anything.
d.ctx: The user is explaining to the expert how she handles people who ask for her WhatsApp number. She tells them she does not share it.
d.j: The user is reporting a past interaction and her refusal to share contact details.

d.seg: तो मैंने कहा तुम इसको डिलीट कर दोगे अच्छा तुम ठीक है मैं कभी किसी से बोलती नहीं हूँ लेकिन तुम अपना व्हाट्सअप नंबर दे दो व्हाट्सअप नंबर या कॉल करने के लिए ताकि मैं खुद तुमको कॉल करके बात करूँ
d.tr: So I said, you will delete it, okay, fine. I never tell anyone, but you give me your WhatsApp number, WhatsApp number or for calling, so that I can call you myself and talk.
d.ctx: The user is telling a story about a previous caller she spoke to, describing how she asked for his number.
d.j: The user is recounting a past conversation where she asked for a number, which falls under reported speech.

d.seg: मैं इस ऐप को साल भर में यूज़ कर रहा हूँ मुझे लगता है अभी तक मुझे मैं जितने लोगों से बातचीत किया हूँ सात आठ फीमेल्स ऐसी हैं जो मेरी फेवरेट लिस्ट में और चार पाँच तो ऐसी हैं जिनका मेरा जिनको मैंने अपना व्हाट्सएप नंबर देकर रखा हूँ
d.tr: I have been using this app for a year. I think, out of all the people I have talked to, there are seven or eight females who are in my favorite list and four or five are such that I have given them my WhatsApp number.
d.ctx: The expert is telling the user about his past behavior on the app with other users.
d.j: The expert is describing his past actions with other users, which is reported speech.
